correctness.rationale: The exact Toeplitz Schur complement gives C={|z|^2+|w-z^2|<=1}; every boundary point of E_J has t=|z|^2 in [0,1/3], and 1-2t is positive. The squared margin for 2t+(2 sqrt2/3)sqrt(1-3t)<=1 is exactly (2t-1/3)^2. Equality forces t=1/6 and w antiparallel to z^2, giving the complete contact circle. In John-normalized real coordinates the uniform harmonic contact circle has mean 0 and covariance I_4/4, providing a global positive John certificate even against tilted and shifted competing ellipsoids. The classical orbit-frame result covers the outer ellipsoid. Disk-fiber integration yields volume(C)=pi^2/3; the John semiaxis product is 8/27, giving volume(E_J)=4pi^2/27 and fraction 4/9. The standalone checker passed exact-rational and numerical controls; finite checks are not substituted for the infinite proof.

Its maximal-volume inscribed ellipsoid is a natural unrestricted affine-geometric invariant. The complete opposite-phase harmonic contact orbit, sharp occupied-volume fraction 4/9 and comparison against the known outer ellipsoid provide a nontrivial exact geometric normalization, not an arbitrary finite parameter or recomputation of an already tabulated quantity. No claim is made beyond this single natural body.
